title: MomentMem: Memorizing Key Moments for Robot Manipulation
description:
arXiv:2611.26745v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Robotic manipulation often requires remembering visual information that is no longer observable, such as the original location of an object. Existing approaches typically rely on full observation histories, which become redundant over long horizons, or text summaries, which may omit precise visual details.
